fields.description: Detects possible DLL hijacking of windows.ui.immersive.dll by looking for versions not meeting the known signature data.
fields.name: Possibly malicious versions of windows.ui.immersive.dll
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\windows.ui.immersive.dll" and (not (not (module.path matches "\.*") or not (module.path matches "\.*") or not (module.path matches "\.*")))))
